text: Natural language processing, or NLP, is a branch of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand and work with human language. Instead of just reading words as simple data, NLP allows machines to grasp the meaning behind sentences, including grammar and context. This technology powers many everyday tools. For example, online translation services can quickly convert text from one language to another, making communication easier across the world. Sentiment analysis is another important use, where computers determine whether a piece of writing, like a product review, is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots, which you might meet on a website, use NLP to understand your questions and give helpful answers, creating a more natural conversation experience.
